feeds.title: Louder Than War
feeds.description: Louder Than War is the UK's fastest growing and award-winning music and culture website. It brings latest music news and reviews, interviews and features as well as discussion on international punk rock and pop culture.

feeds.title: Visit Manchester Blog
feeds.description: Visit Manchester is the official tourism site of Greater Manchester where you can search for things to do in Manchester and find out what's on, as well as getting inspiration for your visit to this fantastic city region. Get the latest events and music shows in the city. artists concerts and more.

feeds.title: Chetham's School of Music Blog
feeds.description: Chetham's is the largest specialist music school in the UK, and the only one in the north of England. Originally established as a charity school in 1653, it became a co-educational, specialist music school in 1969 and, over the last 50 years, has established itself as a central part of music education in the UK. Get the latest news from the school along with events and more!

feeds.title: The Stoller Hall Blog
feeds.description: Built-in 2017, the Hall has been specially engineered to provide a totally immersive experience. Designed as a box within a box, the performance space has very low noise levels and a variable acoustic system, which means audiences can truly hear, feel and almost see the music. Know more about the latest events, music and news from the Stroller Hall.

feeds.title: A&R Factory » Manchester
feeds.description: Since 2012, we have grown into one of the most respected artist and repertoire (A&R) blogs. We help music industry professionals discover new independent music from across the world. Get the latest updates on new music and artists from Manchester.

feeds.title: Nordic Music Central
feeds.description: Covers news and reviews from the burgeoning Nordic music scene, reviews of singles, EPs, albums, live shows, also interviews and special features. No-nonsense critiques. No flowery language. Nordic Music Central is the go-to review site for artists and bands in the Nordic countries, managed from the UK!

feeds.title: Even the Stars
feeds.description: We are Even The Stars, an independent music blog based in Manchester. We're not music journalists, we write about the music we love for that reason in the hope other people might love it too.

feeds.title: Soundsphere Magazine
feeds.description: Soundsphere Magazine is the ultimate guide to alternative culture in the North of England and worldwide. It shares Updates on indie artists, alternative music, punk, rock & goth, movie reviews, gaming, comics & more!

feeds.title: AnalogueTrash Blog
feeds.description: AnalogueTrash is an independent record label, management and promotions company run by Adrian Brian Thompson and Mark Buckley (hello!), based in Manchester, England. Get Independent music news, reviews, alternative and grassroots music in all its forms on our bog

feeds.title: Right Chord Music » Manchester
feeds.description: Right Chord Music highlights new releases from emerging Manchester-area indie artists—showcasing introspective shoegaze, ambient sounds, and vibrant alternative rock.

feeds.title: Louder Than War » Manchester Music News
feeds.description: Read The Latest Manchester Music News & Reviews From The Writers & Contributors at Louder Than War - The Home of Music and Culture

feeds.title: BOOT - - - MUSIC
feeds.description: BOOT - - - MUSIC is a Liverpool music blog and print magazine showcasing the best new music from the North-West and beyond...

feeds.title: Royal Northern College of Music Blog
feeds.description: RNCM's blog blends artist interviews, student insights, research highlights like 'Resonate,' community initiatives, and reflections on music events and experiences.

feeds.title: Groovement
feeds.description: Groovement is a Manchester-based platform where Agent J (Jamie Groovement) curates eclectic beats, jazz, soul, electronica and hip hop—via music features, podcasts, DJ mixes, and new music reveals.

feeds.title: Greater Manchester Music Commission
feeds.description: Blog spotlights how Greater Manchester is amplifying its music scene—from global export initiatives and venue support tools to artist showcases, heritage tributes, and practical resources for the region's music ecosystem.

feeds.title: Priti Shikotra Photography Blog
feeds.description: Recent work & updates from published Manchester & London Music photographer Priti Shikotra.Recent clients include Kerrang! NME BBC & more

feeds.title: The Mancunion » Music
feeds.description: The Mancunion's Music section spotlights live reviews, album critiques, artist interviews, and Manchester gig culture—capturing both buzzing local acts and major performances unfolding across the city

feeds.title: Band on the Wall
feeds.description: A multi-award-winning historic live music venue, promoter and learning centre based in Manchester, celebrating music of excellence from around the world.

feeds.title: Manchester Evening News » Music & Nightlife
feeds.description: Check out the news on Manchester's music and nightlife scene with the latest gigs, artist releases and events.

feeds.title: RGM
feeds.description: Discover the latest music news, reviews, and interviews from the best artists around the world. Stay up to date with RGM through our in-depth features

feeds.title: Tempo Magazine
feeds.description: Tempo Magazine is an indie UK music platform offering fresh single and EP reviews, festival previews, gig coverage, and cultural features—spotlighting the rising voices and underground scenes across the UK's vibrant music landscape.

feeds.title: Viva Manchaster » Music & Culture
feeds.description: Viva Manchester's Music & Culture section spotlights the city's rich sonic tapestry—featuring artist interviews, gig previews, nostalgic Manchester music link-ups, and cultural event showcases.

feeds.title: About Manchester » Concerts
feeds.description: The 'Concerts' section of About Manchester delivers timely announcements and coverage of Greater Manchester's live music scene—from big-name arena tours and intimate club gigs to cultural showcases and touring legends.

feeds.title: Manchester Classical Music Blog
feeds.description: Manchester Classical Music Blog covers articles on classical music, opera, concert reviews and more. Robert Beale is a classical music writer for City Life Manchester and Manchester News MEN.

feeds.title: Midas Blog » Music
feeds.description: Midas blog spotlights the city's cultural resurgence—highlighting initiatives like Beyond The Music, Greater Manchester's new city-wide music conference and festival.

feeds.title: Manchester Camerata Blog
feeds.description: Manchester Camerata is a registered charity working and performing in Manchester and worldwide since 1972. Get the latest about what's on, special events, news and stories from Manchester Camerata.

feeds.title: Still MCR Blog
feeds.description: We produce articles, interviews, playlists and podcasts covering Manchester Hip Hop, Soul, Drum&Bass and other fresh sounds from the city. Still MCR began as a blog page in 2012 and has supported and contributed to documenting Manchester Music, in one way or another, over the last decade.
